Field.Description: Amount (signed) added to the peg for a pegged order.

Field.Name: PegPriceType

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: Defines the replenishment size behavior for a reserve order. Selecting 'Undisclosed' will result in a fully hidden order. This tag should be specified for Pegged and Market orders. This tag should not be specified for fully displayed Limit orders. Currently if this tag is not specified for a Pegged or Market order the default value shall be Undisclosed. This is not recommended as this behavior may change in a future revision of the specification. 1 - Initial 3 - Randomize By Size 4 - Undisclosed (hidden)

Field.Name: ReserveReplenishTimeType
Field.Description: Defines the replenishment timing behavior for a reserve order. This is a custom LTSE tag. 1 - Immediate 2 - Random

Field.Name: DisplayMinIncr
Field.Description: Defines the minimum increment to be used when calculating a random refresh of Display Qty.

Field.Name: SelfTradePreventionType
Field.Description: Defines the desired behavior in the event of a wash. This is a custom LTSE tag. 0 - Cancel Newest 1 - Cancel Oldest 2 - Decrement And Cancel 3 - Cancel Both 4 - Cancel Smallest

Field.Name: StpGroupID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of self trade prevention group. 0 - Prevents orders from the same firm trading with each other. 1 - Prevents orders from the same MPID trading with each other. 2 - Prevents orders from same Sender Comp IDtrading with each other. 3 to 65534 Prevents orders with the same Stp Group ID across a firm from trading with each other.

Field.Name: RiskGroupID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of a custom risk control set to be applied to this order. This is a custom LTSE tag.

Field.Name: RepriceFrequencyType
Field.Description: Defines the frequency of a reprice. If this tag is not sent then the order will not be repriced. This is a custom LTSE tag. 0 - Single Reprice. The order will only be repriced

Field.Name: RepriceBehaviorType
Field.Description: Reprice behavior when market is locked or crossed. This is a custom LTSE tag. 1 - Reprice Lock Cancel Cross. Reprice if the market is locked, cancel if market is crossed. 2 - Reprice Lock Reprice Cross. Reprice if the market is locked or crossed.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: The MPID associated with the new order, if it is not supplied, the MPID assigned as the default MPID for the Port/Account is associated with the new order. This is a custom LTSE tag.

Field.Name: CustOrderCapacity
